# Test tag-filtered live notifications separately from initial SQL results

Current TaggedMessagesFilter supplies SQL and parameters but no Matches override; the base Matches returns false. LiveView uses that native matcher to gate added, removed and flag-change notifications. The tag test checks query results, while testListener attaches an unfiltered view. Proposed focused test: attach a listener to an include/exclude tag view, mutate matching and nonmatching messages and check notifications. Initial SQL correctness does not prove live notification parity. This is a static conditional gap; no runtime failure was reproduced. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Panorama tag notification static test concern.
